query:
SELECT
            s.id,
            s.quantity_available,
            s.quantity_reserved,
            s.low_stock_threshold
        FROM stock s
        JOIN products p ON p.id = s.product_id
        WHERE p.slug       = $1
          AND p.farmer_id  = $2
          AND p.is_active  = true
          AND p.is_deleted = false
